newsitem.title: USA: CME CATTLE AND PORK COMPLEX PRE-OPENING CALLS.
newsitem.headline: CME CATTLE AND PORK COMPLEX PRE-OPENING CALLS.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Heavy deliveries against August and weak cash markets but fund support may continue in back months.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Index down and corn futures called higher. Technical trend points lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Lower cash hog indications and cash pork products easier.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.100 to off 0.200 cent. August seen firm on lack of deliveries, deferreds technically weak.
